property_summary: Callers that are not the jojoTeam must be unable to execute newEmergencyOracle.
newEmergencyOracle can only be called by the jojoTeam address.

After calling newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle contract must be the caller (msg.sender), not address(0). The bug violates this by passing address(0) as the owner, causing the new oracle's owner to be the zero address instead of msg.sender.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle should not be the zero address because the bug passes address(0) as the owner.

After any call to newEmergencyOracle, the newly emitted EmergencyOracle address must belong to a contract whose turnOnOracle() re-ownership can be successfully called by the jojoTeam (because the original caller is the jojoTeam and is set as owner), while the bug sets owner to zero so turnOnOracle() will revert.

After a successful call to newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle contract must be the same as the msg.sender of the call (i.e., the jojoTeam), not address(0); the bug passes address(0) as the owner, so the owner will be address(0) instead of the jojoTeam.

For any description string, a successful newEmergencyOracle call must create a new EmergencyOracle contract whose owner is the jojoTeam (msg.sender), not the zero address; the mutant passes address(0) as the owner, making the new oracle's owner zero.
For any description, calling newEmergencyOracle(description) always creates a new EmergencyOracle with that same description; the buggy version ignores the parameter and stores an empty string.
